notes: The original reference supplied in the blind input is not the original study named in the replication reference list: Katz et al., p.12, cite Owen, Hilsenroth and Rodolfa (2013), Interaction Among Alliance, Psychodynamic–Interpersonal and Cognitive–Behavioural Techniques in the Prediction of Post-Session Change, Clinical Psychology & Psychotherapy 20(6), 513–522. No substituted original was acquired. Original acquisition: DOI publisher 403; Unpaywall and OpenAlex no open full-text location; independent primary-paper search yielded no full text. Replication full PDF was accessible through the web tool cached primary PDF despite direct URL 404; title and DOI verified. Replication was independently examined. Its locator describes several interaction tests without selecting one; effect size and p remain null rather than arbitrarily select a two-way or three-way interaction or use bivariate correlations as interaction effects. All located regression interaction tests use n=106. The requested r is not a printed effect metric for these interaction terms (printed coefficients B and Beta, with t and p). Authors describe the PI interaction as replicated but opposite in direction and the three-way interaction as not replicated; mixed records that narrative. No statistics converted. Unsolicited excluded-domain search hits appeared in initial general primary-paper search; no excluded pages were opened or used; subsequent searches excluded that domain.
